author: Vox
description:
When colleges deny the fact that they have a party scene, does it put students in more danger? Elizabeth Armstrong — sociologist and author of Paying for the Party: How College Maintains Inequality — talks to Vox’s Rachel Cohen Booth about why giving students resources to party responsibly is safer in the long run.

author: Vox
description:
The Ebola virus is spreading at an unprecedented rate this year, with 9,415 confirmed cases and 4,536 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the first five months since an outbreak began. Vox Future Perfect fellow Ananya Rupanagunta explains what is causing this rapid increase in illnesses.

author: Vox
description:
Katie Zacharia had five days in the White House. But before her infamous career as press secretary, she was part of what she described as “sort of” a pyramid scheme: a multi-level marketing gig, or MLM. 

Now, influencers are trying to sell you on the same ideas as an MLM — passive income, being your own boss, and financial freedom. But as journalist Vivian Ho tells Today, Explained, it’s harder than it looks. Listen to the full episode wherever you get your podcasts.
